input.raw: Tells the circle something that happened, in two or more connected sentences in a language they speak, so that listeners can follow.

good.text: The child tells the circle something that happened, in two or more connected sentences in a language they speak, so that listeners can follow.

input.raw: Asks to join a game, and accepts a no or joins in the way agreed.

good.text: The child asks to join a game and accepts a no, or joins in the way agreed.
good.near_miss: Moves into the game without asking first.

input.raw: Notices a classmate who is hurt or crying and does something for them, such as fetching an adult or sitting with them.

good.text: The child notices a classmate who needs help and does something for them, such as fetching an adult or sitting with them.
good.near_miss: Stays with the group and watches, without doing anything for the classmate.

input.raw: Invites a child standing alone at the edge of a game or group to join, before any adult suggests it.

good.text: The child invites a classmate standing alone at the edge of a game to join, before an adult suggests it.
good.near_miss: Invites the classmate once an adult has asked the group to.

input.raw: Keeps an agreement made with a classmate, such as a swap or a promise, without an adult enforcing it.

good.text: The child keeps an agreement made with a classmate, such as a swap or a promise, without an adult enforcing it.
good.near_miss: Keeps the agreement after an adult has reminded them of it.

input.raw: Goes back to a classmate after a conflict to apologise or to sort it out, without being sent.

good.text: The child goes back to a classmate after a disagreement to apologise or to sort it out, without being sent.

input.raw: Speaks up when a classmate is being excluded or mocked, in the moment.

good.text: The child speaks up at the time it happens when a classmate is left out or mocked.
good.near_miss: Takes the classmate's side once an adult has already stepped in.

input.raw: Changes a plan after seeing that it would harm someone else, and says why.

good.text: The child changes a plan after seeing that it would harm someone else, and says why.
